assessments.reasoning: MS-VBAL v20250520 §5.2.1.2 assigns zero as the module default when the procedural or class module declaration section omits Option Base. The section identifies the affected dimensions as those whose declarations leave the lower bound unspecified.

challenge.method: Consider a module that omits Option Base but declares a dimension with an explicit nonzero lower bound.
challenge.results: That dimension supplies its own bound. The module default remains zero and governs dimensions that leave the bound unspecified. The omission rule fixes the value as part of the static semantics.

limitations: An explicit dimension lower bound and host-specific extensions are outside the assertion.
